prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a close-cropped asymmetrical pixie with a shaved temple and a swept-back crown, no hair ornament; costume silhouette a fitted rider jumpsuit with big gloves and a visor hanging at the neck — a fast, forward-leaning silhouette; design idea the ridge-street and its branching steep closes become a central spine closure with diagonal herringbone seams opening into side vents, built into the fitted rider suit; face a sharp, striking, intense look, heart-shaped face; expression a sharp little closed-mouth smile.

A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Scottish woman — the personification of the city of Edinburgh — one woman who IS Edinburgh as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; warm beige skin; heart-shaped face; soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners; hazel eyes; brows with a clean, angled peak; a nose with a soft, rounded tip and natural width; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist build; a close-cropped asymmetrical pixie with a shaved temple and a swept-back crown, no hair ornament; blue-black hair with a cold indigo sheen.
Expression: a sharp little closed-mouth smile.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a short pleated kilt-skirt of fibre-optic tartan whose crossing bands glow violet, teal and red, worn under a cropped jacket with buckled harness straps; a small hip pouch of silver mesh hanging at the front like a sporran, and a thistle-shaped ear cuff glowing faint purple.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a fitted rider jumpsuit with big gloves and a visor hanging at the neck — a fast, forward-leaning silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: the ridge-street and its branching steep closes become a central spine closure with diagonal herringbone seams opening into side vents, built into the fitted rider suit
Colours: volcanic dolerite black, thistle purple and tartan red — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a set of bagpipes with clear crystal drones and chanter glowing soft violet, the bag wrapped in glossy smart-fabric tartan; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Edinburgh two centuries from now, a far-future city on its volcanic ridge: the castle on its black crag and the whole old stone town of tall tenements and steep closes kept exactly as they stand, softly lit from within; the long ridge-street alive with a summer festival of a thousand stages, rippling light-banners and floating screens of street performers; across the green valley the pale columned new town and beyond it slender terraced towers of pale stone and glass shaped like stacked basalt columns; a softly glowing transit line gliding toward the old port; the old volcano hill washed in heather-purple light; quiet flying vehicles in lanes over the firth under a bright, pale northern summer night sky.
This card: on the long ridge-street of the old town during the summer festival two centuries on, crowds and street performers all around, light-banners rippling between the stone tenements and the castle crag glowing above.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: Standing squarely with weight balanced, the bagpipes supported by her left hand; her right hand rests naturally open beside her hip.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
